literal: Exterior purity by water is established; interior purity by truthfulness is seen.
translation: Outward purity is achieved by water, while inward purity is manifested by truthfulness.
modern: உடலின் புறத்தூய்மை நீரினால் உண்டாகும்; உள்ளத்தின் அகத்தூய்மை வாய்மையால் (உண்மையால்) வெளிப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet draws a clear contrast between physical cleanliness and moral purity. The author explains that while water is sufficient to cleanse the external body (puram), it cannot wash the inner self or mind (akam). Inner purity can only be achieved and made visible to others through truthfulness (vaymai) in thought, speech, and action. Thus, truthfulness is presented as the ultimate purifying agent for the human soul, just as water is for the physical body.
